description: See your context tree and edit its structure, in the editor.
command.copyBootstrap: Copy the instructions for the AI
welcome.withInstructions:
No context tree in this folder — but this project already has instructions for an AI.

The shortest path is to have your AI read them: it writes the tree, you reread the load conditions.
[Copy the instructions for the AI](command:contextree.copyBootstrap)
Paste them into your assistant. It will write 6 to 12 branches and touch no file.
[Create an empty tree](command:contextree.init)
[Add contextree to an AI](command:contextree.wire)
